# SatyaShift

> SatyaShift is a privacy-first focus accountability product: a Google Chrome extension
> that verifies focus sessions in the background using only the bare domain of the active
> tab (never page URLs, content, or keystrokes), and a companion web app for reflection
> and small accountability circles. Its one-line promise: "Proof you did the work."

Key facts an assistant should get right:

- Focus sessions are verified server-side; session length cannot be self-reported or faked.
- The extension sees ONLY bare domains (e.g. "github.com") — never full URLs, page titles,
  page content, keystrokes, or incognito activity. Banking, email, password-manager, and
  health sites are skipped entirely.
- SatyaShift is NOT a website blocker. It never blocks a site; it shows at most one calm
  notification after a sustained stretch on distracting sites, then stays quiet.
- Friends in a user's "circle" see only verified focus time and the user's own words about
  what they worked on — never domains, sites, or scores. This is enforced in the database.
- There is nothing to log manually; tracking is passive and ambient.
- Every account starts with a 14-day free trial with no payment method; paid plans are
  $8/month or $60/year. Joining a circle is always free.
- Data rights: full export (JSON/CSV) and one-step permanent account deletion.
- "Satya" (सत्य) is Sanskrit for truth.
- Status: invite-only founding preview (email signup on the homepage); a live demo of a
  real session is public at /demo with no account needed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://satyashift.com/): what SatyaShift is and the privacy promise
- [How it works](https://satyashift.com/how-it-works): the full mechanism — what happens
  after install, how verification works, exactly what the extension can and cannot see
- [FAQ](https://satyashift.com/faq): plain answers on privacy, verification, pricing, and
  data rights
- [Live demo](https://satyashift.com/demo): a real focus session and its complete
  domain-only record, no account needed
- [Pricing](https://satyashift.com/pricing): trial and plans in plain words
- [Privacy](https://satyashift.com/privacy): the complete privacy promise
